summary_en: Interim dividend raised 30 yen to 140 yen/share; year-end dividend raised 31 yen to 171 yen/share; total FY3/27 dividend 311 yen (from 250 yen prior guidance). Reflecting upward revision of FY3/27 earnings guidance: net income to parent raised to 23.0 B yen (+24.3%), EPS to 776.43 yen.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of earnings forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 (upward revision) and revision of dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, SWCC Corporation's board resolved to revise both its earnings forecast and dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2027, reflecting stronger-than-expected H1 FY3/27 performance and positive business momentum. Earnings guidance was raised: consolidated net income to parent increased from 18.5 B yen to 23.0 B yen (+24.3%), and EPS from 624.66 yen to 776.43 yen. Dividend per share is being raised in both periods: interim dividend increased 30 yen to 140 yen/share, and year-end dividend increased 31 yen to 171 yen/share, bringing the total FY3/27 dividend to 311 yen from the prior forecast of 250 yen. The upward revisions are attributed to robust demand in domestic power infrastructure (driving increased production of SICONEX®), strong U.S. AI data-centre demand for e-Ribbon®, and better-than-anticipated semiconductor probe-pin orders including China-bound demand. The company maintains its basic policy of securing internal reserves for future business development while continuing stable dividend distributions.
